cues: How does the kidney make urine four times more concentrated than blood?
The ascending limb pumps salt out into the medulla, but it is waterproof.
The descending limb, running the other way right beside it, lets water out into that salty fluid.
text: How does the kidney make urine four times more concentrated than blood? The loop of Henle. The ascending limb pumps salt out into the medulla, but it is waterproof. The descending limb, running the other way right beside it, lets water out into that salty fluid.
